rca_of_issue: SMOKE-01/05 fail because the DB (/api/platform/languages) now returns 6 languages with blueprint_enabled=True. The P0 code fix (removal of mfd_language_registry_override from getLanguageRegistry() chain) is intact and functioning. The expected DB state from iter_224 was 2 active languages; current state is 6. Most likely cause: a test agent in iter_224 or an intermediate session saved all 6 blueprint operational languages as active via LanguagesPage /admin/languages. The SALVA button in LanguagesPage persists the toggle state to DB.
